fact: The /taskbook-new handler calls t3_thread_launch with workspaceStrategy.type=worktree. T3 creates and manages the worktree.
/taskbook-new derives the T3 clientRequestId from the taskbook digest, so retrying unchanged input submits the same request identifier.
A prepared launch rereads the taskbook and verifies its digest, pinned base, worktree when supplied, and expected branch before execution.
When reading a T3 worktree binding, the plugin checks the local Git root and current branch against the binding.
The /taskbook-new handler validates launch parameters with prepareTaskLaunch before requesting the T3 worktree through launchT3Thread.
